title: fix(plugin-grid): over the 5000-record cap, the select-all-matching bulk bar says only the first 5000 matching records will be processed
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbQQZgSv2t6j3vyRpg7oswBa)_

Fixes #28552

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:列表「选择全部匹配记录」的批量栏,在匹配数超过 5000 时,横幅、「选择全部」按钮、已选计数和选区右键菜单都改为点名上限,例如「将处理前 5000 条（共匹配 7200 条记录）。」;5000 及以下文案不变。上限与实际取数(`resolveBulkRows`)读同一个常量 `BULK_SELECT_ALL_MATCHING_CAP`。
- **为什么改**:维护者裁决(#28345 第 ④ 条)。原来横幅按服务器总数说「已选择全部 7200 项」,批量删除实际只处理前 5000 条,屏幕上什么都不说,是破坏性路径上的静默部分执行。
- **风险与回滚**:低。只改 plugin-grid 的三处文案选择和十个语言包各加三条 `grid.*` 文案;取数逻辑、上限数值、接口都不变。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/components/BulkActionBar.tsx`(`overCap` 三处分支)、`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/bulkSelectAllMatchingCap.ts`、`BulkActionBar.selectAllMatchingCap-28552.test.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/BulkActionBar.selectAllMatchingCap-28552.test.tsx packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/bulkFanoutHostParams.test.tsx`,预期 2 个文件、16 个测试全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **One constant.** `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/bulkSelectAllMatchingCap.ts` holds `BULK_SELECT_ALL_MATCHING_CAP` (5000) and `exceedsBulkSelectAllMatchingCap(totalMatching)`. `resolveBulkRows` in `ObjectGrid.tsx` stops its paged fan-out at that constant (it was a local literal), and every string below reads the same constant. The module is not exported from the package entry.
- **Over the cap, the bar names it** (`BulkActionBar`): the select-all button reads `grid.bulkSelectAllMatchingCapped` ("Select the first 5000 of 7200 matching"), the banner after selecting reads `grid.bulkAllMatchingSelectedCapped` ("Only the first 5000 of 7200 matching records will be processed."), and the count chip reads `grid.bulkSelectedAllMatchesCapped` ("5000 selected (of 7200 matches)").
- **The selection's context menu** (`SelectionContextMenuItems` in `RowContextMenu.tsx`) counted `totalMatching` with the same `grid.bulkSelectedAllMatches` key; over the cap it now reads the same capped key. This is the same defect on the second surface that renders the count, so it is fixed here.
- **At or under the cap, nothing changes**: the three existing keys, with `count`, as before.
- **Strings** (`@object-ui/i18n`, `grid` namespace, all ten built-in packs): three new keys interpolating `cap` and `total`. They take no `count`, so they are not i18next count families. In `ru` and `ar` the total stands alone (in parentheses or after a preposition with no noun) so no noun has to agree with it; the cap is always 5000.
- One root changeset: `@object-ui/plugin-grid` patch, `@object-ui/i18n` patch. No `packages/spec/**`, no server change, no metadata key.

## Why

Ruling 6545938831 on #28345, item ④, verbatim: 「bulk-select-all-matching: file a product defect card — the banner names the cap (e.g. 「将处理前 5000 条」); the checklist gains one criterion pinning it.」 The checklist criterion rides #28551, not this PR.

**Clause-② reading** (measured on the built declaration closure, objectstack `a2e75562`, `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/plugin-grid^...'`, 49/49 tasks): plugin-grid exports no language pack (its `package.json` has only the `.` entry). The grid strings live in `@object-ui/i18n`, which publishes `./locales` and `./locales/*` and re-exports `en` and `type TranslationKeys` (`typeof en`) from its `.` entry; the built `dist/locales/en.d.ts` declares each leaf as a readonly string literal. So the three new keys widen the published declaration of `en` and `TranslationKeys`: `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, as amended on the card's Claim. Nothing is narrowed and no metadata author surface moves: `Metadata-protocol: none`, patch.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/BulkActionBar.selectAllMatchingCap-28552.test.tsx`, nine cases, strings read from the packs and the cap from the constant:
  - the constant is the 5000 the fan-out pin already holds;
  - over the cap (7200 matches, a 50-row page): the button reads the capped key and not today's; after selecting, the banner reads the capped key and contains the cap, and the chip reads the capped key; under `zh` the banner reads the `zh` pack; the selection's context menu reads the capped key;
  - exactly at the cap (5000) and under it (1200): the button, the banner and the chip read today's three keys.
- `bulkFanoutHostParams.test.tsx`, "still honours HARD_CAP over a match set larger than the cap": in the same ObjectGrid run that delivers 5000 of 6000 records to the bulk delete, the banner now reads the capped key filled with `BULK_SELECT_ALL_MATCHING_CAP` and 6000, and the delivered length equals the constant. So the number shown and the number delivered are pinned in one run.

## Acceptance notes

- The numbers are shown unformatted (5000, not 5,000), the same as every existing count in these strings.
- The banner is only reachable when the host passes find params (`canOfferSelectAllMatching`), unchanged.

## Verification

All at head `a9224125` (this branch merged `origin/main` `cd065d36`; the merge touched none of this diff's packages, and the delta against main is still these 17 files, +246 / -15), in a worktree, every build and test under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`.
